Avery (People Ops): Heads up folks — annual privacy refresher + attestation window opens tomorrow. All full-timers and active contractors must complete the 20-min microtraining and submit the attestation form by Mar 15 11:59pm PT.
Sam (Product): Thanks. Is this the same module as last year or a new curriculum?
Avery (People Ops): Updated — we added a short case-study on telemetry handling and a checklist for customer data minimization. Expect ~20 mins total.
Ivy (Eng): For teams who already ran team-level training, can we submit a consolidated attestation?
Lina (Legal): Consolidated attestations are allowed if you include the roster of attendees + timestamps for each team session. Please attach meeting notes.
Noah (Security): Important: if your service ingests PII, attach a dataflow diagram (png or pdf) and the retention policy excerpt. Missing those will flag your attestation for manual review.
Avery (People Ops): Submission steps: 1) Complete microtraining: https://training.redwood.example.com/privacy-2026 2) Fill attestation form: https://forms.redwood.example.com/privacy-attest 3) Upload artifacts (if required) to https://files.redwood.example.com/privacy-attest-subs (SSO).
Avery (People Ops): File naming for artifacts (please follow exactly):
```
privacy_<team>-<artifact-type>-<YYYYMMDD>.pdf
example: privacy_search-dataflow-20260312.pdf
```
Compliance Bot: Reminder: 7 days until privacy attestation deadline. You have 1 incomplete training and 0 uploads remaining.
Ivy (Eng): One followup: retention policy excerpt — is a link to the internal retention page okay or do we need a PDF snapshot?
Lina (Legal): Please include a PDF snapshot of the specific policy section (timestamped). Links alone won't pass audit.
Sam (Product): If someone is on parental leave and can't sign by the deadline, what should we do?
Avery (People Ops): Put them in the exception field on the form and add an expected return date. We'll grant a 14-day extension case-by-case.
Noah (Security): Office hours this week for anything attestation-related: Tue 10am PT and Fri 4pm PT. Drop into #calendar for invites. I'll be there to answer dataflow questions.
Compliance Bot: Office hours events added to calendar.
Ivy (Eng): Uploading dataflow + retention PDF now.
Avery (People Ops): Thanks — small ask: if you upload multiple artifacts, include a brief manifest.txt listing filenames and a one-line purpose for the reviewer. Makes the pass much faster.
Sam (Product): Heads-up that Product's module will handle attestation for two squads (Search + Relevance). I'll upload a single roster and two PDFs.
Lina (Legal): Also a reminder re: international teams — if you're subject to different privacy laws (e.g., CCPA, GDPR), include the mapping note in the manifest. We'll escalate as needed.
Avery (People Ops): Final note: incomplete attestation by the deadline may temporarily remove access to customer data workspaces until cleared. We prefer not to do that, so please complete on time. If you have any blocker, DM me. :pray:
Compliance Bot: Final countdown: 72 hours to deadline.
